android.desc:
Crush oversleeping with Awake – a loud alarm clock for heavy sleepers with wake-up missions and checks. It's a free alarm clock, clock app, alarm app for heavy sleepers. 

Awake makes sure you really get out of bed. Set powerful alarms, add missions, and let the wake-up check verify you’re actually awake – not just half-snoozing your phone.

⭐️ Wake-up missions
• Many mission types to get body and brain moving
• Object scanning, Open-Eyes detection and many other AI - style missions to get out of bed
• Quick thinking challenges to switch off sleep mode

⭐️ Wake-Up Check
Still lying in bed after stopping the alarm? Awake sends a follow-up wake-up check. If you don’t react in time, the loud alarm clock starts again. Built for chronic snoozers and heavy sleepers.

⭐️ Smart Morning Briefing
Start the day with a customizable briefing screen:
• Personal note to yourself
• Local weather and today’s highs and lows
• Today’s calendar events with a shortcut into Google Calendar
• Google Tasks: review, complete, and quickly add new tasks
• Daily quote for a mindset boost
• Rotating news headlines you can tap to open
Reorder cards and swipe them away for the current session.

⭐️ Google Tasks & Calendar
Deep integration with Google Tasks and Google Calendar so your to-dos and events are part of your wake-up routine.

⭐️ Extra clock tools
• World clock with local weather
• Multiple timers
• Simple, precise stopwatch

Awake is your loud alarm clock, clock app, and alarm app in one – built to wake you up on time and start the day prepared.

Awake has been positively reviewed and featured by large YouTubers and blogs!

⭐ Top 15 Best Android Apps – HowToMen | 900,000 subscribers
"And this might just be the best new alarm clock app that you can get. It looks a lot like the Google Clock app, which is great cuz it feels familiar, but it's packed with features designed to actually get you out of bed."

⭐ Top Android Apps – Kah Nogueira | 500,000 subscribers
"This app is for those of us who need to wake up every day. It creates an alarm with challenges to disable, so you’ll really wake up."

⭐ Top Android App – NextPit
"It's not just another alarm app—it actively forces me to engage with it so I can’t just roll over and go back to sleep.”
